name: epicurus_residual
description: Within-patient-percentile logistic residual: genuine PRIME + NetMHCpan-EL + expression. Trained ONLY on the independent CD8-multimer cohort; applied frozen to external cohorts.

formula.percentile: per-patient rank(pct=True) of the oriented raw feature; NaN->0.5
formula.score: decision_function on standardized percentiles; higher = better

external_validation_status.gartner_nci_testing: residual vs PRIME hits@20 +0.115 CI[0.000,0.231] CONSISTENT_WITH_NO_EFFECT (directionally up, unestablished; CI touches 0)
external_validation_status.improve_srhgroup: residual vs PRIME hits@20 -0.114 CI[-0.271,+0.029]; directionally worse and FAILS to beat PRIME, but CI crosses 0 = NOT statistically significant. Project verdict REJECT = failed-to-establish-superiority (challenger-vs-baseline rule), not significantly-worse.
external_validation_status.improve_denominator: pre-screened candidate denominator (~200 candidates/patient), NOT full somatic universe; aggregates >=3 sub-cohorts (RH-/Neye-/BC-).
external_validation_status.verdict: NOT PROVEN to beat genuine PRIME on untouched external patients. Do not claim superiority.
